units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 61a:13">Bekh. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>להכי אמדתיך</he> I guessed this was thy intention.
Keth. 68ᵃ הא דאמידניה in the one case it means that we have formed an opinion about him (know whether he is stingy or liberal).—Part. pass. אָמִיד.
Arakh. 20ᵃ הא א׳ וקאי he stands appraised, he has been valued before this.—Hence אָמִיד believed to be wealthy.
<cite ref="Ketubot 85b:4">Keth. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>ידענא ביה דלא א׳</he> I know he is not rich.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 52a:4">Ib. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>אם אֲמִידָא לך</he> if you believe her to be wealthy. V. <cite ref="A00691"><he>אוּמְדָּנָא</he></cite>.
